name: hdf4
title: HDF4
source: HDF4 (the HDF Group's Hierarchical Data Format 4)
inputs: HDF4 files, HDF-EOS2 ones among them: the scientific datasets of numbers and text the SD interface wrote, plain, linked, deflated or chunked, the writer's Vdata tables, their attributes, and the writer's Vgroups
for: HDF4 and HDF-EOS2 files (`.hdf`) of NASA's EOS-era archives, such as MODIS, SeaWiFS and AIRS products, as labeled arrays
